description:
FILED s473t6a (Opus, 2026-09-17) by #1501 ROUND 8 (t6a), CHECK 1 of
t/op/method.t.  PRE-EXISTING.  ~11 blessed rows, and the die aborts a form.

perl lets a CORE builtin be called as a method with the `CORE::` prefix:

    "3foo"->CORE::uc     # perl: 3FOO
    "Foo"->CORE::uc      # perl: FOO

PROBED (scratch/s473t6a/probes/misc1.pl, perl 5.40.3 vs PCL 2ac855aa): BOTH
die in PCL --

    Can't locate object method "uc" via package "3foo" (perhaps you forgot to
    load "3foo"?)

THE TASK'S OWN CORRECTION: the round's first reading blamed the digit-headed
class name, because that is the spelling t/op/method.t uses (line 562).  The
probe kills that: `"Foo"->CORE::uc` dies identically.  The fact is the
`CORE::` METHOD form, not the class name.

WHAT IT COSTS: the die at method.t line 562 aborts its top-level form, so perl
rows 126-134 (`method call on ::`, `on ::main`, `on empty string`, and the
TYPEGLOB invocants `method call on typeglob ignores package`,
`*glob->method is equiv to (\*glob)->method`, `$pvlv_glob->method`) plus the
three rows after the file's SKIP block are never produced.  Those typeglob rows
are #1664's (the typeglob model) once the abort is gone.

Line 563-564 of the file shows the SECOND half, which PCL already answers
right: with `@{"3foo::ISA"} = "CORE"` in place, `"3foo"->uc` is 3FOO in both.
So the machinery for a CORE method through @ISA exists; what is missing is the
`CORE::`-qualified METHOD NAME resolving to the builtin.

FIX SHAPE: `p-method-call`'s name resolution has a `SUPER::` arm and a
fully-qualified arm; `CORE::NAME` needs one more, answering the builtin the
runtime already exports (the same table `prototype("CORE::NAME")` reads --
`%pcl-core-prototypes`, #1586).  PROBE THE BREAKING CASE: a user package
literally named `CORE` must still be reachable, and `CORE::GLOBAL::` overrides
are a different mechanism (#233 (e)).
subject: CLASS->CORE::uc (a CORE:: METHOD call) dies "Can't locate object method" -- not about the digit-headed class name; the die aborts a form in t/op/method.t
